headline: Indiana American Water and Congressman Frank J. Mrvan Highlight Workforce Development at New $1.8 Million American Water Training Facility in Northwest Indiana
summary: Indiana American Water and U.S. Rep. Frank J. Mrvan today previewed the new American Water Training Facility in Gary, a hands-on learning environment designed to strengthen workforce readiness, support operator training, and help prepare the next generation of skilled workers in the water industry.
